description:
## Objective

Add executable examples for Action and Flow compilation.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U9`
Covers: `R1, R2, R4; KTD1, KTD2, KTD4, KTD6, KTD8.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.8 (U8) — Add the example catalog harness must be complete.
- Unblocks: jido-07x.20 (U20) — Enforce quality gates in CI and agent guidance must be complete.

## Files

Read `../refs/jido_action/examples/01_compilation/**` and matching source tests at Action commit `40ec1f0af3a373bae5e6d869017cc229c85aef92`. Add `examples/flow/compilation/**` and `test/examples/flow/compilation/**`. Change the manifest.

## Instructions

1. Port the single-step, dependency graph, DSL Flow, stored JSON, authoring equivalence, validation, input/output, and compiled program examples.
2. Use current modules and one application.
3. Keep exact documented output assertions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each of the eight source example IDs has a manifest disposition.
- [ ] Every ported example has a README, source, and passing paired test.
- [ ] No separate-package application module appears.

## Verification

- `mix test.examples test/examples/flow/compilation` exits with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.

comments.text: Ported all eight Action compilation example IDs to the unified catalog. Added examples/flow/compilation sources and READMEs, eight paired tests, catalog entries, and nine manifest dispositions. Adapted old forms/Registry/Zoi contracts to current components/Jido.Codec/Jido.Catalog/Jido.Joi contracts and kept the documented exact outputs and dependency data. Verified focused examples (11 passed), full mix test.examples (18 passed), catalog (7 passed), manifest (6 passed), compile warnings, formatting, diff checks, and no separate-package application module. Commit: 359ac1b. Deferred assets: none in this group. Deviations: current validation asserts stable messages and detail fields because the old reason field no longer exists.

title: Port Action compilation examples
